recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: one prompt split across eleven different model minds
spreadsheet commandments pinned above the desk
summer fog settling over san francisco at fourteen degrees
overcast august evening, wind at twelve kilometers
agents imagined from a phone shortcut tray
shipping by sunrise still on the horizon

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Eleven model orbs orbit a central prompt — tap each orb the instant it flashes your assigned color before the comparison window slams shut.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: nailing the final orb in a perfect eleven-beat streak under a minute
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: orbs orbit faster and swap colors mid-round
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: terminal green nodes pulsing on charcoal void

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Drag formula tokens between spreadsheet cells — each correct placement unlocks the next row before error cascades propagate downward.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: completing one clean column without triggering a #REF! chain
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: merged cells appear and decoy formulas multiply each round
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: cream ledger paper with ink-red error highlights

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Draw one continuous shortcut path from phone icon to agent terminal — thread through iOS widget gates without lifting your finger.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: one unbroken stroke triggers the agent and fills the progress bar
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: widget gates rotate and ghost paths fade behind your trail
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: frosted glass iOS shortcuts over midnight blue

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick deployment crates uphill through rolling summer fog — each crate must land on the sunrise dock before the overcast thickens.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: the last crate sliding into dock at the golden edge
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: fog drifts sideways and crates gain weight mid-arc
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: muted watercolor SF hills in grey-blue fog
